subject: Virtual Full-Loop Coordination: Senior Infra — panel order & buffer plan
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Alex Romero <alex.romero@hightower.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Sep 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Virtual full-loop: initial availability + panel sequencing

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for interviewing with Redwood. We're excited to move to a virtual full-loop for the Senior Infrastructure Engineer role. To make the day smooth for you and our panel, quick ask: can you share any constraints for the week of Sep 23–27 (all times Pacific)? Specifically:

- Preferred days/time blocks (AM/PM)
- Any hard no-gos for back-to-back long sessions (we typically build 3.5–4 hour blocks)
- Need for breaks or accessibility accommodations

Proposed structure (draft):
1) Systems design (60m) — infra + core services
2) Deep dive / coding exercise (70m) — take-home + live review
3) Org fit + cross-team sync (40m)
4) Debrief & final Qs (30m) — hiring manager + recruiter

We usually put a 30–45 minute buffer between 1 and 2 to allow panel switch and short breaks. Attaching your resume and the full_loop_rubric we’ll use for debriefs.

If you prefer we can also split into two shorter sessions across two days; let me know.

Thanks —
Priya
Priya Natarajan
Senior Talent Partner, Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.com
(415) 555-0124

Attachments: candidate_resume_alex_romero.pdf (resume), full_loop_rubric.pdf (rubric)

Hi Priya / Markus —

Thanks — excited to proceed. A few notes: I’m on Pacific time. Best windows for me that week are:
- Tue 24: 10:30–15:00 PT
- Wed 25: 08:30–12:30 PT

Prefer one-day format if possible but I do want at least a 30–40 minute break after the systems design session; long windows back-to-back are rough for me. I’ll need a short closed-captioning requirement (ASR ok) — nothing else special.

If you split across two days, Tue morning + Wed morning also works.

Happy to confirm once you send a proposed schedule.

Best,
Alex

Markus/Marissa — forwarding Alex's availability. Quick internal coordination:

- Candidate prefers one day but requests 30–40m break after systems design. Markus, you wanted systems design first?
- Panel we had in mind: Teresa (core infra), Daniel (storage), Karthik (reliability), coding lead (TBD), then HM debrief.
- Can we compress the coding exercise to 60–65m if we give him a 40m break? That keeps total on one-day to ~4 hours plus buffers.
- Assign debrief owner: Marissa usually runs the rubric; are you ok to own the debrief and collate scorecards?

Also, we should include 15-minute pre-join for internal panel to sync expectations. I’ll draft the calendar once you confirm order.

— Priya

Thanks Priya — I agree systems design first. Minor tweaks:

- Order: Systems design (Teresa + Daniel) -> 40m break -> Coding (Karthik + backend lead) -> Org fit (HM + cross-team) -> Debrief.

- Pre-join: 15m for panel sync (review rubric focus areas). Marissa, can you lead the debrief and send the scorecard template to panel before the interview?
- If any panel cannot do Tue 24 midday, we should fallback to splitting Tue AM + Wed AM; avoid Wed afternoon unless absolutely necessary.

Marissa — tagging you to confirm debrief ownership and that you can circulate the rubric by EOD tomorrow.

-Markus

Hi Alex —

Thanks for the quick reply. Based on panel availability we can do a one-day session on Tue, Sep 24. Draft schedule below (all PT):

- 10:30–10:45 — Panel pre-join (internal) — Teresa, Daniel, Karthik, backend lead, Marissa, Markus
- 10:45–11:45 — Systems design (Teresa + Daniel)
- 11:45–12:25 — Break for candidate (40m) + brief internal reset
- 12:25–13:30 — Coding exercise (Karthik + backend lead) — 65m
- 13:30–14:10 — Org fit and cross-team sync (Markus + HM)
- 14:10–14:40 — Debrief & final questions (Marissa + Markus)

Total candidate-facing time: ~4 hours including brief breaks. I’ve blocked the calendar and included a Google Meet link and a short doc with the exercise prompt and etiquette notes: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123 and https://drive.google.com/open?id=1XyZ-rubric

Accessibility: we’ll enable live captions for all sessions. Please let me know if you’d prefer a two-day split — otherwise I’ll send the calendar invite and prep packet with the pre-join note to panel.

Confirming attachments again: your resume is attached and the debrief rubric will be shared with panelers prior to the pre-join.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Priya
